COHR 301.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 301.description: Balancing organizational, personal, and community interests in a global economy. In addition to standard management textbooks and readings, the class will draw from the work of poets, fiction writers, essayists, and social critics. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 302.course_name: Critical Evaluation of Information, Evidence, and Arguments
COHR 302.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 302.description: Strategies to critically evaluate information relevant to Human Resource Managers. This course will examine common errors in logic, decision biases, and cause and effect relationships. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203 and one of COMM_V 191, COMM_V 291. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 303.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 303.description: Processes of workforce recruitment, selection, retention, and renewal. Includes human resources planning, development of an effective staffing strategy and employer brand, job analysis and descriptions, cost-benefit analysis of various recruiting methods, analysis and evaluation of selection methods. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 304.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 304.description: Employee training, development and performance management in a variety of employment settings. Application of various training methods to performance enhancement, performance appraisal, feedback, and empirical evaluation of training investments. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 305.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 305.description: Employee compensation, including pay systems, benefits systems, and rewards and recognition programs. Examination of the motivational underpinnings of compensation administration and the application of compensation principles to the achievement of employer strategic objectives. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 307.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 307.description: Frameworks from the social sciences useful for understanding organizational processes and how to apply these frameworks to particular organizational consulting challenges. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 308.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 308.description: Integrated coverage of union-management relations including labour law, collective bargaining, and collective agreement administration. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 310.course_name: Industrial Relations in an Era of Globalization
COHR 310.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 310.description: Comprehensive examination of the Canadian industrial relations system, and its legal foundations, in the context of a global economy. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 311.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 311.description: An analysis of organizational structures and intraorganizational processes; effects of organizational factors on individual behaviour. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 401.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 401.description: The tactics and strategies for implementing constructive modifications in organizations. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 402.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 402.description: Explores the characteristics of effective leadership and examines how to be a better leader. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 403.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 403.description: Explores the business and legal cases for diversity in the workplace. Examines how to effectively manage a diverse work force. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 404.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 404.description: Examines the sources and consequences of power in the context of different corporate and national cultures. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 405.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 405.description: Managing and working in a family business presents unique challenges: family issues can conflict with business issues. This course examines governance structures and tools to manage the interface between the family and the business. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 406.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 406.description: Application of human resource management practices to multinational enterprises. Comparative analysis of national human resource management systems. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 407.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 407.description: Methods and techniques to diagnose and solve a broad range of organizational problems from the perspective of an organizational consultant. [3-0]. Prerequisite: All of COMM_V 203, COHR_V 307. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 408.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 408.description: Techniques and approaches for evaluating and adjusting the structures of organization. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 409.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 409.description: Techniques and approaches to managing creativity and innovation in organizations. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 410.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 410.description: Techniques and approaches to managing knowledge and learning in organizations. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 411.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 411.description: Techniques and approaches for building effective teams, handling decision-making in teams, creating reward structures, and developing appropriate leadership models. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 412.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 412.description: Understanding, critiquing, and analyzing behaviour and social processes in organizations. This course focuses on provocative and current topics that could not be covered in depth in the introductory course. [3-0]. Prerequisite: COMM_V 203. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 433.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 433.description: Introduction to legislation and application of legal principles that govern the employment relationship. [3-0]. Prerequisite: All of COMM_V 203, COMM_V 393. This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.

COHR 486.course_name: Special Topics in Organizational Behaviour and Human Resources
COHR 486.faculty: Faculty of Commerce and Business Administration
COHR 486.description: This course is not eligible for Credit/D/Fail grading.
